## Types of changes

<!--- What types of changes does your code introduce? Put an `x` in all the boxes that apply: -->

- [ ]  Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ]  New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ]  Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ]  Documentation Update (if none of the other choices apply)
- [ ]  Refactor (improving internal structure/design without changing external behavior)

## Checklist:

<!--- Go over all the following points, and put an `x` in all the boxes that apply. -->
<!--- If you're unsure about any of these, don't hesitate to ask. We're here to help! -->

- [ ]  My code follows the [AquaPower Style Guide](docs/cpp/cpp_style_guide.md) (or relevant style guide).
- [ ]  Functions and classes are adequately documented.
- [ ]  I have added (or updated) unit tests or an example to cover my changes.
- [ ]  My code passes linting/formatting checks.
- [ ]  I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) document.
- [ ]  I have updated the documentation accordingly (if my change requires it).
- [ ]  All new and existing tests passed.
- [ ]  I have avoided making significant changes to the overall architecture without prior discussion.
